name: Makiba Farmstay
description: Makiba Farmstay is a tranquil WordPress theme designed for working dairy farms, countryside guesthouses, and agritourism retreats. Featuring a distinctive fixed hill-ridge timeline, elegant serif typography, and unhurried editorial layouts, it brings daily agrarian rhythms and family hospitality to life. Built with block-first architecture, clean responsive patterns, and dedicated accommodation templates.
